login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your account to continue.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Enter your name and email. We will send a link for you to create your password.
register.privacyNotice: By creating an account, you agree to the <link>privacy policy</link>.
register.sent: Done! If this email can be used, we sent a link to finish signing up. Open the email and create your password.
register.sentHint: Not there in a few minutes? Check your spam folder and the Promotions and Updates tabs. The link is valid for 24 hours.

validation.nameMax: The name must be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.emailMax: The email must be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.passwordLength: The password must be between {{min}} and {{max}} characters.
validation.passwordTooLong: The password is too long: with accents or emojis, the 72-character limit gets shorter.

signedOutEverywhere: You signed out of all devices. Sign in again to continue.
accountDeleted: Your account and all your data were deleted.

google.error: Could not sign in with Google.
google.privacyNotice: The first time you sign in with Google, an account is created with your Google name and email, and you agree to the <link>privacy policy</link>.

forgot.title: Forgot my password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email and we will send a link to create a new password.
forgot.sent: If there is an account with this email, we sent a link to create a new password. It is valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Not there in a few minutes? Check your spam folder and the Promotions and Updates tabs.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: After the change, you are signed out of every device where your account is open.
reset.missing: This address does not have the full link. Open the link in the email again or ask for another one.
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with the new password.

createAccount.title: Create your password
createAccount.subtitle: Last step: choose the password for your {{appName}} account.
createAccount.missing: This address does not have the full link. Open the link in the email again or sign up again.
